info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Program Trading API
info.description: The Program Trading API allows for the automated execution of buy and sell orders on behalf of wholesale trading clients. It facilitates complex trading strategies that require precise timing and market conditions, making it essential for financial institutions and asset managers looking to optimize their trading operations. Users can submit, manage, and track multiple program trades effectively. Ideal consumers include traders and financial analysts involved in high-frequency trading or programmatic transaction execution.
